$comment: gzip byte ceilings for dist javascript. Ratchet down as the skeleton matures; raising a budget requires review.

notes.devkit: 5400 -> 6400 (v9.14): the paired report gains the resolution of its own deltas — pairedResolution (Wald interval on the paired difference, the smallest difference the cases could detect at 80% power, and the rule of three when two arms never disagreed) plus casesForEffect, which turns an observed discordance rate into the number of cases a 2pp claim would need. Measured 5352 -> 6281 B gzip over both module formats: about 0.9 KB for a capability the report quotes on every comparison, priced here rather than absorbed silently. The package had 48 B of headroom, so no existing export was near its ceiling and none was removed to pay for this.
notes.ai: 35000 -> 36000 (v9.3): the pairwise selector adds a prompt builder, a parser and a knockout loop, about 1.1 KB gzip. Reviewed as a capability rather than drift, and the two prompt builders were merged onto one rules block and one candidate renderer first, which returned 155 B. 36000 -> 39000 (v9.9): the empty-result turn adds the message builder, the blind control's text and the retry loop, plus a second exported builder so the runner continues the same conversation instead of rebuilding it — about 1.6 KB gzip over both module formats. A capability, priced here rather than absorbed silently. 39000 -> 41000 (v9.13): the decomposition prompt adds a rule block and a reader that takes the last block, plus one exported parser and its step counter — about 0.7 KB gzip per module format, and the ceiling moves by the smallest step that keeps a capability from being absorbed silently. 41000 -> 42000 (v9.21): the per-call meter files each call under the purpose it declared, so a multi-call arm's bill can be read as a table rather than an argument. Measured 40281 -> 41271 B gzip over both module formats: about 1.0 KB for a bucket map, its accumulator and three exported types, after the character and token loops were merged onto one write point and the internal label constant was kept out of the public surface. A capability, priced here rather than absorbed silently; the ceiling moves by the smallest step that keeps it from being absorbed.
